## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 tools/lint.py` passes
- [ ] `claude plugin validate --strict` passes for the marketplace and each changed plugin
- [ ] Every new or changed rule has a source fetched for this change, or a reproducible test
- [ ] Evals added or updated for changed skills
- [ ] `plugin.json` version bumped and `CHANGELOG.md` entry added, if a plugin changed
- [ ] No internal data: no customer or company names, hosts, IPs, emails, commit hashes or issue IDs
